note: Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre & Gunnison NF, on paved CO-133 just south of McClure Pass (~26.7 mi east of Paonia, near Marble) at ~8,200 ft, at the head of Lee Creek: a quiet aspen-shaded campground with beaver ponds nearby for trout fishing. ~8-10 sites, ~35-ft average spurs plus 2 pull-throughs (not stated by the Forest Service). No OHVs or livestock in the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed vault toilets, no water, first-come only (no recreation.gov listing), $14 (2026); added season note (late spring to early fall), fee detail. No agency site count or length exists; note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Site count and lengths: the FS page gives neither, there is no recreation.gov listing or catalog, and the archived FS page could not be reached (archive.org offline). The note's '~8-10 sites, ~35-ft average spurs plus 2 pull-throughs' and the stored pull_through have no agency source; nothing contradicts them, so left in place.
Status: FS 'Site Open' with Current Conditions 'NO SERVICE OR RESERVATIONS' (no services; it was never reservable).
Hookups (electric 0, no water/sewer) are note-derived; the FS page lists none. Left unchanged.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront): weak creekview lead. On imagery the campground road runs SE from CO-133 into aspen; Lee Creek and its beaver channels meander through the open meadow ~60-120 m south of the road. No site points to check; not changed.
Pin 39.12380,-107.31280 is ~45 m from the FS coordinate (39.12413,-107.313774) and sits on the campground road. OK.
